notes.title: Major Update 1.5
notes.notes:
We have worked hard and are excited to introduce this major update to you. It includes many changes and fixes based on player feedback, as well as a small part of new content. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.5) of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710780/530be3ace6791e571e52c167c28c30271412d31f.png

List of changes: 

 Added a dungeon with new content, including a new type of mushroom enemy and a resource building. The entrance to the dungeon is located near the altar of magic. 
 Added a message about saving progress when exiting to the main menu. 
 Added highlighting for the currently used save slot. 
 Changed the controller binding system. Players can now use PS, Xbox, and Switch controllers. 
 Changed the functionality of the left stick on controllers to register inputs in all directions for smoother character movement. 
 Changed the altar of healing functionality. It no longer consumes life essence if the character's health is full. 
 Fixed many visual bugs, including enemies getting stuck in walls, the king's hands disappearing, and ground textures disappearing while moving. 
 Fixed the counter for the achievement “Kill 30 enemies using X weapon”, where X denotes the type of weapon. 
 Fixed SFX issues and added new sounds. 
 Various other fixes. 

Buy the game now to avoid missing the 33% discount on Kingsgrave in celebration of the new update: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave/ 

Thank you for your support and help in making Kingsgrave better!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.3 with optimization improvements and changes controller’s keybinds
notes.notes:
The update, including various game improvements, is now available! We have improved optimization, made changes to the functioning of SFX and their settings, and also made changes to controller support. 
Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.2.3) version of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710780/d76e28f45b2de17e4b28112bd7e55ead3f7ee3a6.png
 
List of changes: 


 Improved optimization and performance. 
 Changed the keybinds for controllers  
 Added the sound for volume adjustment, allowing you to tweak sound levels without leaving the menu. 
 Added vertical synchronization. 
 Added a marker to the dash progress bar, so now you can easily understand when you can do two dash. 
 Added the ability to activate a new day immediately after teleporting to the torch. 
 Fixed SFX issues, they will no longer be too loud. 
 Fixed an issue with shields beingactivated when closing the map on controllers. 
 Fixed an issue with wooden monster spawn creating enemies when the king is not nearby 
 Fixed an issue with resource collection messages appearing over windows. 

Thank you for leaving feedback and helping us make the Kingsgrave better! Please stay tuned for news about future updates. 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.7 with fixes for saves functionality
notes.notes:
The third update with major bug fixes is now available! Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.1.7) version of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710780/d3a537e867f163d32f7d2c7ab2053e192ac6a670.jpg

List of changes:


 Fixed a major issue with players' saves breaking halfway through the game.
 Fixed an issue with items falling into water. All items that were lost in the water will be returned to their initial position after this update.
 Fixed an issue with sounds being loud even if the volume was turned down to 0 in the settings, as well as addressing most other SFX issues.
 Fixed an issue with the arena in the Lava biome working incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue with the torch option "start a new day" being unavailable when a player died near a torch during or after area clearance.

If you lost your saves before this update, please write to us via steamsupport@alawar.com, and we'll send you working saves.

Thank you for your support and help in making Kingsgrave better!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave/

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.4
notes.notes:
This is the second update for Kingsgrave which includes optimization improvements and other fixes. Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.1.4) version of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710780/fab3ccad77f2942b53f37da95a911b685c770849.png

List of changes: 


 Fixed an issue with FPS dropping during long gaming sessions. Currently, we are continuing to work on improving stability of FPS. 
 Fixed an issue with items falling into the water. If you encountered this issue, you will need to start a new game, and in that case, everything will work correctly. 
 Fixed an issue where the skip day window was incorrectly displayed. 
 Fixed an issue where the king got stuck in the textures of the mine after using the dash and pressing “E” on the ladder. 
 Adjusted the tutorial of using oil for destruction spawner pit. 

Known issues:  


 Sometimes the torch may not work if you want to skip the day to restore health. This issue will be fixed in future updates. 


Currently, we are continuing to work on the the issues that will be resolved in the upcoming updates: 
 

 Fixing an issue with SFX. 
 Implementing balance adjustments. 
 Improving optimization for Steam Deck. 
 Adding support for PS4/PS5 controllers. 
 Adding optimization for stick control. 
 Adding "Settings" to the pause menu. 


Thank you for leaving feedback and helping us make the Kingsgrave better! Please stay tuned for news about future updates. 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave

notes.title: News regarding the update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We regret to inform you that the update we had promised to release today for Kingsgrave has been delayed. The issues we were trying to fix have turned out to be more serious than we initially anticipated. We believe that releasing an unprepared version now would only lead to further complications and potentially introduce new issues.

Therefore, we have made the decision to delay the update until tomorrow when we are confident that it works correctly and does not add any new problems. Our team is working diligently to address these issues and ensure that the update is stable.

We apologize for any inconvenience this delay may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding. We will keep you updated on our progress.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Kingsgrave Release Date Reveal & Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.notes:
Greetings, Royals! 

We are thrilled to announce that the launch date for our royal adventure has been chosen. Train your spirit and body, clean up your equipment, and sharpen the spears – we're moving toward the darkness on... 

April 17th, 2024!

[previewyoutube=Y_1uok6nk84;full][/previewyoutube]

Kingsgrave is a gloomy adventure set in a world where a dreadful disease has struck the kingdom, claiming the lives of its people. You are the one who can resist the darkness and save the lands that were once a peaceful and serene home for folks. 

As the only King, in Kingsgrave you will: 

 Collect resources, build houses, and slay enemies to level up your skills and bring the smallfolk back home 
 Destroy the plague creatures to clear the lands of rotting monsters to bring life back to the wastelands 
 Sharpen your combat skills and obtain more powerful equipment to overcome formidable adversaries 
 Explore the abandoned lands, going through traverse woods, deserts, volcanoes, and other biomes in the handcrafted interconnected world 
 Solve cunning puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and navigate treacherous terrain 

The demo for Kingsgrave will be available as part of Steam Next Fest, starting February 5th. 
Arise, mighty monarch, from your prolonged slumber and accept your destiny: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave/

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.1.0.24
notes.notes:
Greetings, Kings and Queens!

During the playtest, you’re helping us find several critical issues in Kingsgrave. It took some time, but we fixed them!

Here is the list of changes:

 Fixed an issue where the map shows unexplored territories.
 Fixed an issue where push button puzzles work incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue where the king isn't visible during the revival.
 Fixed an issue where UI elements do not open with a mouse click.
 Fixed an issue where the dialogue arrow was aimed at the cartographer while the king was speaking.

We're so grateful for your cooperation. Keep sending feedback, and we’ll do our best to improve the game.

If you haven’t played the playtest yet, feel free to join now and wishlist Kingsgrave:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave
